svg.text: Microsoft Azure Set | 04 Building Intuition for DNS
A and CNAME records in the DNS zone on DC-1, resolved from Client-1, and how the local DNS cache affects the answer.
Microsoft AzureDC-1 and Client-1 from section 01, same resource group and virtual network
DC-1's IP, then a new IP
Client-1 pings and looks up mainframe before it exists; DC-1 has no record, so both fail.
On DC-1, add an A record for mainframe with DC-1's private IP; Client-1's ping now replies.
Change the A record to a new IP; Client-1 still uses the old IP from its DNS cache.
ipconfig /flushdns clears the cache, and mainframe now resolves to the new address.
On DC-1, add a CNAME record named search that points to a public website name.
ping search and nslookup search follow the alias out to the public website.
